label: Bible Study
prompt: So God created man in his own _____, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them.
verse: So God created man in his own image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them.
note: Imago Dei — every person you meet today carries it.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: God is our _____ and strength, a very present help in trouble.
verse: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
note: Not a distant help — a 'very present' one. God is closer than the trouble is.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And they shall make an ark of _____ wood: two cubits and a half shall be the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.
verse: And they shall make an ark of shittim wood: two cubits and a half shall be the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.
note: The ark of the covenant was built of shittim wood — modern versions say acacia, a tough desert tree.

label: Deep Water
prompt: God is not a man, that he should _____; neither the son of man, that he should repent: hath he said, and shall he not do it? or hath he spoken, and shall he not make it good?
verse: God is not a man, that he should lie; neither the son of man, that he should repent: hath he said, and shall he not do it? or hath he spoken, and shall he not make it good?
note: Balaam was hired to curse and could only bless: God doesn't take back his word — or need to.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: The _____ shall not depart from Judah, nor a lawgiver from between his feet, until Shiloh come; and unto him shall the gathering of the people be.
verse: The sceptre shall not depart from Judah, nor a lawgiver from between his feet, until Shiloh come; and unto him shall the gathering of the people be.
note: Jacob's deathbed prophecy of Messiah's tribe — and yes, the KJV spells it the British way.
